description: This file defines logging utilities, severity levels, macros for logging and checking conditions, and support for streaming STL objects, specifically tailored to distinguish itself from Google GLog by its naming and implementation. It appears to be a custom logging header for the c10 namespace, used in the PyTorch codebase.
